ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { page: 0, next: null, hasMore: true, records: 0, seenCursors: [], types: {} }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { complete: !vars.typesState.hasMore, pages: vars.typesState.page, records: vars.typesState.records, types: vars.typesState.types pluck ((value, key) -> { code: key as String, name: value }) orderBy ((item) -> item.code as Number default 0) }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, pages: vars.typesState.page default 0, message: error.description default "Falha ao consultar os tipos de cliente no ARTSOFT." }

when.expression: #[vars.typesPage.next != null and (vars.typesPage.next == vars.nextValue or (vars.typesState.seenCursors contains vars.typesPage.next))]

raise-error.description: O ARTSOFT devolveu um cursor next repetido.

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.typesState ++ { page: vars.typesState.page + 1, next: vars.typesPage.next, hasMore: vars.typesPage.next != null, records: vars.typesState.records + sizeOf(vars.typesPage.rows), seenCursors: if (vars.typesPage.next == null) vars.typesState.seenCursors else vars.typesState.seenCursors ++ [vars.typesPage.next], types: vars.typesState.types ++ ( vars.typesPage.rows filter ((r) -> !isEmpty(r.code)) reduce ((r, acc = {}) -> acc ++ { (r.code): r.name }) ) }
